book.name: 1 Abhakoriinto
book.title: Enyaarubha yo okutaanga ya Pauro ku Bhakoriinto

content: Emirimo gya abheega
Abhaatu bhatubhare etwe kubha ni bhabhagati bha Krisito, tuheerwe emirimo gyo okwiimeererera amangʼana ge embiso ya Taatabhugya.
Bhoono, omuutu wuno aheerwe emirimo, areenderwa abhe omuhokya omuheene.
Nawe kweenye, etari kigiro niraatinirwe ekiina neemwe, eraabhe niraatinirwe ekiina na abhatini bhe ekiina mukiina. Naabhe enye omweene nitakutura okwiitinira ekiina,
kwo okubha nitakurora ryoryoosi eriibhiihu mukoro yaane. Nawe riyo ritakugirya nitabha ni isarya. Omukuru Yeesu niwe akunitinira ekiina.

Bhoono, mutatinira ekiina abhaatu eriibhaga ryaabhu rikyaari kuhika, muganye tee orusiku runo Omukuru Yeesu araaze. Ewe niwe araarore ebhigiro bhyoosi bhino bhibhisirwe mukiirima no okweerekya gano gari muziikoro zya abhaatu. Niho omuutu akubhona omukumo guno akweenderwa, okurwa ku Taatabhugya.

Abhahiiri bhaane, nigaambiri amangʼana gayo goosi iguru waane na Apooro, okubha tubhe ekireengyo kwiiguru weenyu. Okutuukana kwe ekireengyo kiyo, mumenye gano gakugaambwa mubhugaambi bhuno, “Mutiitaambuka gano gakaamirwe mu Makaamo Amahoreeru.” Eraabhe muratuniirira obhugaambi bhuyo, atakubhaho omuutu wowoosi wuno akumukumya omuutu owumwe no okumuzeera owuundi.
Bhoono, ni weewi wuno akukoriri obhe omukuru kukira owuundi? Ni kigiroki kino onakyo kino otaheerwe na Taatabhugya? Eraabhe oheerwe, kwaki oriikumya kyamuna otaheerwe?
Bhoono muriirora mwiigutiri! Muriirora muniibhiri! Muriirora abhatemi kukira etwe! Hakiriku muungabheeri abhatemi eheene, okubha etwe tubhaahe hamwe neemwe!

Nawe, niriiseega Taatabhugya atukoriri etwe abheega kubha abhaatu bho okuzeerwa kukira bhoosi. Tubheeri kya abhaatu bhano bhatiniirwe ekiina okwiitwa. Tutuurirwe kya abhaatu bho okusekwa mukyaaro, kubhamaraika
na kubhaatu.

Abhaatu bhaaru bharaturora etwe bhatuumbaahu, kwo okubha turamuhokeerya Krisito, nawe emwe muriirora bha amangʼeeni kwo okubha muramutuniirira Krisito. Etwe turarorekana kubha bhanyookobhu, nawe emwe muriirora muna amanaga. Etwe turazeerwa, nawe emwe muriirora abhasuukwa.
Tee bhoono, tune enzara ne enyoota, na tutana eziingibho zyo okwiisa, turatemwa, na tutana ho okwiikara.
Turakora emirimo gyeetu kwo omukya na kwa amabhoko geetu abheene. Hano abhaatu bhakututuka, turabhatweera ebhite. Hano bhakutunyaakya, turiikongʼeererya.
Hano bhakutugaamba bhubhi, tukabhakyoora kwo okubhiisasaama. Naabhe, turarorwa kyo obhunyaka bhwe ekyaaro, na tutakweenderwa kwa ryoryoosi.
Nitakubhakaamira amangʼana gano kubhasuukya, nawe ndeenda okubharekya kya abhaana bhaane abhaseegwa,

kwo okubha yiingabha muna abhaatu ebhikwe ikumi (10,000) bhano bhakubharera mubhwiikari bhweenyu bhwe Ekikrisito, wuuso weenyu ni wumwe. Enye ni wuuso weenyu ku Krisito Yeesu, kwo okubha enye niwe niabharwaaziiri Amangʼana Amazomu.
Bhoono, nirabhiisasaama kubha, mubhe muratuniirira ekireengyo kyaane.

Riyo niryo rigirye nimutumeenie Timoteo, omwaana waane omuseegwa, omuheene mumirimo gyo Omukuru. Ewe arabhahiitya gano enye nikugatuniirira kwo okugwaatana na Krisito, gano nikweegya abhaatu ahagiro hayo hoosi mumakanisa goosi.
Bhoono abhaandi gati weenyu bhariizuungya, kwo okubha bhariiseega nitakuuza kweeki kweemwe.

Nawe Omukuru araaseege, niraaza kweemwe bhwaangu. Hayo niho niraamenye amangʼana gano bhakugaamba bhano bhakwiizuungya, ne etari okumenya amangʼana gayo ageene, nawe okumenya naabhe eziinguru zyaabhu.
Niragaamba ego kwo okubha obhutemi bhwa Taatabhugya,
bhutakurorekana mumangʼana ageene, kiindi muziinguru zyaabhu.
Bhoono, mureenda nikorebhwi? Mbe, niize kweemwe ne ehiimbo okubha nibhateme? Kasi niize kwo obhuseegi no obhunyoohu?

footnotes.text: Bhamaraika. Rora engʼana maraika mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
Obhutemi bhwa Taatabhugya ni hagiro hayo hoosi hano Taatabhugya niwe omukaangati. Rora amangʼana gano mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
